label: Aurora Veil
author: Conky-Studio
description: Cinematic aurora ribbons: layered translucent sine bands that drift and breathe. Soft, premium motion for a backdrop or hero accent. Optional Trigger boosts brightness and speed.

properties.label: Trigger
properties.help: 0-100: higher = brighter and slightly faster motion.

lua_draw_body:
local x0, y0, W, H = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local amp = {amplitude}
 local lw = {line_width}
 local n = math.floor({bands} + 0.5)
 if n < 1 then n = 1 end
 local energy = math.min(math.max((tonumber({trigger}) or 0) / 100, 0), 1)
 local speed = {speed} * (0.7 + 0.6 * energy)
 local t = wall_clock() * speed
 local ra, ga, ba = {color_a}
 local rb, gb, bb = {color_b}
 local steps = math.max(48, math.floor(W / 4))
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
 cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
 for band = 1, n do
  local u = (band - 1) / math.max(n - 1, 1)
  local r = ra + (rb - ra) * u
  local g = ga + (gb - ga) * u
  local b = ba + (bb - ba) * u
  local phase = t * (1.0 + u * 0.55) + band * 1.7
  local ybase = y0 + H * (0.2 + 0.6 * u)
  local band_amp = amp * (0.65 + 0.35 * math.sin(band * 1.3 + t * 0.4))
  local a = {opacity} * (0.35 + 0.65 * energy) * (0.55 + 0.45 * (1 - math.abs(u - 0.5) * 1.2))
  -- soft under-glow pass
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 1.8)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, a * 0.25)
  cairo_new_path(cr)
  for i = 0, steps do
   local px = i / steps
   local xx = x0 + px * W
   local yy = ybase
     + math.sin(px * 2.4 * math.pi + phase) * band_amp
     + math.sin(px * 5.1 * math.pi - phase * 1.3) * (band_amp * 0.28)
   if i == 0 then cairo_move_to(cr, xx, yy) else cairo_line_to(cr, xx, yy) end
  end
  cairo_stroke(cr)
  -- main ribbon
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, a)
  cairo_new_path(cr)
  for i = 0, steps do
   local px = i / steps
   local xx = x0 + px * W
   local yy = ybase
     + math.sin(px * 2.4 * math.pi + phase) * band_amp
     + math.sin(px * 5.1 * math.pi - phase * 1.3) * (band_amp * 0.28)
   if i == 0 then cairo_move_to(cr, xx, yy) else cairo_line_to(cr, xx, yy) end
  end
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
